CELESTIAL

A free open-air arts and music festival rooted in the streets of Laiki Geitonia; and a growing vision for culture in Cyprus.

Our Mission

More than a festival.

Celestial was born out of a simple belief: that people deserve a cultural event that belongs to everyone; not behind a fence, not for a select crowd, but in the open streets.

Our goal is to develop Celestial Arts & Music Festival into a cultural institution that embraces all forms of art, supports emerging creators, provides a platform for the new generation of artists, and fosters active youth participation in culture and cultural development in Cyprus.

Edition 01 proved the concept. Edition 02 will build the institution.

What Celestial stands for

01
All Forms of Art
From live music across seven genres to visual art exhibitions and street installations; Celestial is a platform without borders between disciplines.
02
Emerging Creators
We actively seek out and champion new voices; giving artists and musicians a stage before the world catches up with them.
03
Youth & Community
Celestial is free, open to all ages, and designed around the neighbourhood. Culture should not be gated; it should belong to the street.
04
Cyprus First
Every artist, every venue, every collaborator is local. Celestial exists to prove that Cyprus has everything it needs to create world-class cultural events.
